[
مَشَاعِلِىٌّ , a rel. n. formed from مَشَاعِلُ pl. of مَشْعَلَةٌ, is a n. un. of which the coll. gen. n. is مَشَاعِلِيَّةٌ, and signifies A bearer of the cresset called مَشْعَلَة: hence applied also to a nightman: and hence, to a cleanser of wells: a scavenger; or remover of offal and the like: and to an executioner. (See De Sacy's Chrest. Arabe, sec. ed., i. 201–203; and Quatremère's “ Hist. des Sultans Mamlouks, ” sec. part, 4 and 5.)]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
